claim: A roofed sector standing in an open street whose sky is far above it draws its upper wall from its roof all the way up to the street's sky (eleven bodies on Gravesend's quay), a tall slab, because the upper step is drawn whenever either side is roofed. Stalls, decks and kiosks in the open have the street's sky as their ceiling and are roofed with sprites.
evidence: NBlood/source/build/src/engine.cpp:4688 (classicDrawBunches) draws the upper step unless both ceilings are parallax
Gravesend's market stalls and the Demeter, 2026-11-25 (projects/blood-city/references/market-design.md items 1 and 9; built in projects/blood-city/level/l3_market.py)
use: Leave small open-air structures parallax-ceilinged and roof them with flat or wall sprites.

checked.how: engine.cpp:4688 (classicDrawBunches): 'if (((sec->ceilingstat&1) == 0) || ((nextsec->ceilingstat&1) == 0))' then the upper step is drawn: only when both ceilings are parallax is it skipped. market-design.md:15-17 (stalls: one counter sector, roof and poles are sprites) and :39-40 (a roofed sector under a sky eleven bodies up draws a wall to its top). bloodmap/skyline.py has no stall or roof rule (lowered_skies, thin_fronts measure skies); the stalls are built in projects/blood-city/level/l3_market.py:477.
